_comment: Golden set for the moderation pipeline. This file deliberately contains
slurs and hate-speech examples: it exists so the system provably catches
them and provably does NOT flag the clean set. Grow it from real
hate[]: label='hate'. regex_must_catch=true means the deny-list layer
alone MUST flag it (deterministic CI gate). regex_must_catch=false means
it carries no listed slur — catching it is the model's job (live tier).
clean[]: must never trip the deny-list; the live tier reports how often
the model wrongly calls them hate.
